ABJURERS STRIKE.text:
UTILITY WARDING
Tradition arcane, divinity, ethereal
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Range touch; Targets 1 weapon
Duration 1 minute
You touch a weapon granting it wondrous power for a short period of time. For the duration of the spell the weapon treats all targets as unarmoured and ignores all magical bonuses to DB. 
If this spell is cast upon a missile weapon, then it affects the ammunition that is fired from it.

ACID ARROW.text:
ACID ATTACK INVOCATION
Tradition arcane, verdant
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Range 60 feet; Targets 1 creature
Base Damage 1d8; Duration Sustained (1 minute)
You imbue one of your hands with acidic energy. As part of casting the spell you launch an arrow of acid at one target within range which inflicts 3d8 acid damage and 1d4 recurring damage. At the beginning of each turn, you may Sustain the Spell to make an Attack action using your Spellcraft skill to launch an additional arrow of acid at one target within range.
WARPING OPTIONS
+2 PP: The damage increases by 1d8 and the recurring damage by 1.

ACID BOLT.text:
ACID ATTACK INVOCATION 
Tradition arcane, verdant
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Range 30 feet; Targets 1 creature
Base Damage 1d6
You unleash a crackling bolt of corrosive acid that streaks toward your target with destructive force. If you hit, you deal 4d6 acid damage plus 2 splash acid damage and on a critical hit, the target also takes 1 recurring acid damage.

ACID CLOUD.text:
ACID PENETRATING SAVE TRANSLOCATION
Tradition arcane, verdant 
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Range 120 feet
Area fog spreads in 20-ft. radius, 20 ft. high
Saving Throw Fortitude
Duration 1 minute (D)
The area floods with a mass of misty vapours. The cloud may be stationary or move 10 ft. away from you each round (choose when the spell is cast). All creatures within the fog become concealed, and all creatures outside the fog become concealed to creatures within it. Each creature that starts its turn in the spell's area must make a Fortitude saving throw.

Success The target takes 1d6 acid damage.
Failure The target takes 2d6 acid damage and a -20 critical injury.
Fumble The target takes 3d6 acid damage and critical injury.
WARPING OPTIONS
+4 PP: increase the acid damage by 1d6.

ADAPT BODY.text:
UTILITY WARDING
Tradition ethereal 
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Duration 8 hours
Your body automatically adapts to hostile environments. You can adapt to underwater, extremely hot, extremely cold, or airless environments, allowing you to survive as if you were a creature native to that environment. You can breathe and move (though penalties to movement and attacks, if any for a particular environment, remain), and you take no damage simply from being in that environment. 
You can somewhat adapt to extreme environmental features such as acid, lava, fire, and electricity. Any environmental feature that normally directly deals damage per round deals you only half the usual amount of damage.
WARPING OPTIONS
+2 PP: increase duration to next daily prep.

ALARM.text:
UTILITY WARDING
Tradition all 
Cast 10 minutes (material, somatic, verbal)
Requirements 3 gp of silver dust sprinkled in a circle.
Range touch; Area 20-foot radius
Duration 8 hours (D)
You create an invisible magic sensor which warns you of intrusion with an audible or mental alarm that triggers whenever a small or larger corporeal creature enters the area without speaking a pre-defined password. The audible alarm can be heard within 60 feet. The mental (which gains the mental trait) alarm can only be heard by you and has a range of 1 mile.

WARPING OPTIONS

Tradition verdant

Range 120 feet
Duration see text

You can affix a note or tiny object of up to 1 lb to it. The animal does its best to reach the destination; if it makes it there, it waits nearby until the duration expires, allowing other nonhostile creatures to approach it and remove the attached object. The spell ends after 24 hours or when a creature removes the attached object, whichever happens first.
If there are no Tiny wild animals in range, the spell is lost.

ANIMAL SPIRIT.text:
ALTERATION MORPH UTILITY
Tradition verdant
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Duration 10 minutes (D)
You draw in the spirit of an animal to gain some of its physical qualities. You alter part of your body, without major physical changes. Any gear that you have, including armour, automatically adjusts to the new form. 
When you cast animal spirit, you must select one of the following options and apply its benefits for the duration of the spell. 
Bear: You take on an aspect of a bear. You gain a +1 Natural DR and a +2-status bonus to the Athletics skill. 
Frog: Your legs become elongated and muscular. You gain a +4-status bonus on Jump (Athletics) checks, and you always jump as if you had a running start.
Gorilla: Your arms become long, flexible, and strong like those of a great ape. You gain a medium Slam attack, and you gain a +4-status bonus on grapple checks.
Monkey: Your hands and arms become dexterous like those of a simian. You gain a +2-status bonus on Climbing checks, and you can throw objects as if you had the Throw Anything feat.
Otter: Your hands and feet gain webbing, and your lungs gain capacity, allowing you to move through the water with ease. You gain a Swim speed equal to half your speed, and all the benefits of having a swim speed. Additionally, you can hold your breath for twice as long as normal before being forced to make Constitution checks to keep holding your breath.
Tree Lizard: Your hands and feet gain climbing claws and climbing pads. You gain a climb speed equal to half your normal speed and all the benefits of having a natural climb speed. 
Be aware that you may only take on one animal spirit at any one time (unless you use the below warping option).
WARPING OPTIONS
+2 PP: you increase the duration to 1 hour.
+2 PP: you may take on an additional trait.

ANTIPATHY.text:

Tradition arcane, divinity, ethereal, verdant 
Cast 1 hour (material, somatic, verbal)
Range 30 feet; Area 1 object or 1 30’ radius location (B)

APOCALYPSE.text:

Tradition arcane, ethereal 
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Range 120 feet; Area 30’ radius (B) 
Saving Throw Will
Duration 1 minute
All creatures in the spell’s radius believe that the world is ending around them in the most cataclysmic way. The effects of the spell are dependent upon each targets saving throw
Critical The target takes 2d6 mental damage before realising that the events are not real. The target is then immune to this casting of the spell.
Success The target takes 2d6 mental damage and must make a fresh saving throw at the beginning of their next turn.
Partial As success but the target also takes a minor critical injury.
Failure The target takes 4d6 mental damage and a serious critical injury. The target may make a fresh saving throw at the beginning of their next turn. 
Fumble As failure, but the target takes a deadly critical injury.
If at any point every affected character gets a success or greater on their saving throw, the spell immediately ends.

Tradition arcane, ethereal 
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Range 30 feet; Targets 1 creature
Saving Throw Will
Duration 1 minute
You fill an enemy's head with waking dreams, a reminder of the pleasures, delights, and terrors to be found in the dream world. 
The effect is based upon the targets Will Saving Throw.
Success The target is unaffected 
Failure While in this strange dream state, the target moves at half its normal speed (round down to the next 5-foot increment).
Fumble As failure and the target is also slowed 1 for the duration.

HEAL.text:
HEALING SOUL UTILITY
Tradition divinity 
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Range Touch; Targets 1 living or undead creature
You channel divinity energy into a creature to wipe away injury and afflictions. You immediately end any and all of the following adverse conditions affecting the target: ability damage, blinded, confused, dazed, dazzled, deafened, diseased, fatigued, injured, sickened, stunned & weakened. It also cures 100 HP of damage, 10 points of bleed and 50 points of soul drain. 
WARPING OPTIONS
+1 PP: heal an additional 10 HP or 5 soul drain.

HEALING EARTH.text:
ALTERATION CANTRIP EARTH UTILITY
Tradition verdant
Cast 1 AP (somatic)
Range 5 feet; Targets a handful of dirt or mud
Duration 10 minutes
You transform dirt or mud into a malleable earth with healing properties. This claylike substance can be used instead of traditional healer's tools for performing Medicine checks to Administer First Aid or Treat Wounds. 
If the earth remains unused until the spell's duration expires, or if you cast the spell again before using it, the earth reverts back to its original non-magical form of ordinary dirt or mud, losing its healing properties.
CASTER LEVEL MODIFICATIONS
CL 5: The earth grants anyone using it to Administer First Aid or Treat Wounds a +1 item bonus to the Medicine check.

HEIGHTENED AWARENESS.text:
INSIGHT REVELATION UTILITY 
Tradition arcane 
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Duration 1 hour
You enter a heightened state of awareness that allows you to notice more about your surroundings and recall information effortlessly. You gain a +1-circumstance bonus on Notice (Perception) checks and Recall, Knowledge checks that you are trained in.
If this spell is active when you have to make an initiative check, you can instantly dismiss this spell and gain a +20 bonus on that check.
WARPING OPTIONS
+2 PP: increase the bonus by +1 (max +4).

HEROISM.text:
ENCHANTMENT MENTAL UTILITY
Tradition divinity, ethereal 
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Range touch; Targets 1 creature
Duration 10 minutes
You bring forth a surge of bravery and prowess within the target. The target gains a +1-status bonus to attack checks, saving throws, and skill checks.
WARPING OPTIONS
+4 PP: the bonus increases by +1 (max +4).

HIDE FROM UNDEAD.text:
SAVE WARDING
Tradition divinity, ethereal 
Cast 2 AP (material, somatic)
Range touch; Target 1 creature
Saving Throw Will
Duration 10 minutes
Undead cannot see, hear, or smell creatures warded by this spell. Even extraordinary or supernatural sensory capabilities cannot detect or locate warded creatures. Nonintelligent undead creatures (such as skeletons or zombies) are automatically affected and act as though the warded creatures are not there. An intelligent undead creature gets a single Will saving throw. If it fails, the subject can't see any of the warded creatures. If it has reason to believe unseen opponents are present, however, it can attempt to find or strike them. If the target takes any attack action or casts an essence energy spell, the spell ends.
WARPING OPTIONS
+1 PP: you can target an additional creature (max 5).
+2 PP: increase duration to 1 hour.

HINDSIGHT.text:
INSIGHT REVELATION UTILITY 
Tradition arcane, divinity 
Cast 10 minutes (material, somatic)
Area 20-foot radius
Duration Sustained (1 minute)
You project your vision and hearing back in time at your current location to a point up to 1 day ago. You may observe events in real time or skim them at up to 60 times their normal rate (e.g. observing a minute in a second). 
You may make skill checks at the location as if you were there, but these checks have a -5-circumstance penalty when skimming.
WARPING OPTIONS
+2 PP: you may project up to 1 week ago.
+2 PP: you may Sustain the Spell for up to 10 minutes.
+4 PP: you may project up to 1 month ago.
+6 PP: you may project up to 1 year ago.
+8 PP: you may project up to 10 years ago.
+10 PP: you may project up to 100 years ago.

HOLD ANIMAL.text:
ENCHANTMENT MENTAL SAVE
Tradition verdant 
Cast 2 AP (material, somatic)
Range 30 feet; Target 1 animal
Saving Throw Will; Duration varies
You block signals from the targets brain to paralyse them.
The target animal must attempt a Will save.
Critical The target is unaffected.
Success The target is stunned 1.
Failure The target is paralyzed for 1 round.
Fumble The target is paralyzed for 4 rounds. At the end of each of its turns, it can attempt a new Will save to reduce the remaining duration by 1 round or end it entirely on a critical success.
WARPING OPTIONS
+1 PP: you can target an additional creature (max 5).
+4 PP: you can target a creature of the beast type.

HOLD KIND.text:
ENCHANTMENT MENTAL SAVE
Tradition arcane, ethereal 
Cast 2 AP (material, somatic)
Range 30 feet; Target 1 creature of your race type
Saving Throw Will; Duration varies
You block signals from the targets brain in an attempt to paralyse them.
The target must attempt a Will save.
Critical The target is unaffected.
Success The target is stunned 1.
Failure The target is paralyzed for 1 round.
Fumble The target is paralyzed for 4 rounds. At the end of each of its turns, it can attempt a new Will save to reduce the remaining duration by 1 round or end it entirely on a critical success.
WARPING OPTIONS
+1 PP: you can target an additional creature (max 5).
+4 PP: use the spell on a creature of a different race type.

HOLY SHOUT.text:
AUDITORY ENCHANTMENT SAVE WORD
Tradition divinity 
Cast 1 AP (verbal)
Area 20-foot-radius (B)
Saving Throw Will
You shout at the top of your lungs releasing a powerful prayer of stunning. All creatures who are your enemies must make a saving throw.
Critical The creature is unaffected.
Success The creature is stunned 1.
Partial The creature is stunned 2.
Failure The creature is stunned 1 round per 2 failure.
Fumble The target is unconscious for 1 round per 4 failure.

HORRID WILTING.text:
ESSENCE SAVE SOUL
Tradition arcane, verdant 
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Range 200 feet; Area 30-foot radius
Saving Throw Basic Fortitude
Base Damage 1d10
You draw the moisture from the targets' bodies. All creatures in the area of effect take 12d10 essence damage. 
Creatures made of water (such as water elementals) and plant creatures use the outcome for one degree of success worse than the result of their saving throw and have any criticals increased by one step. Creatures whose bodies contain no significant moisture (such as earth elementals) are immune to horrid wilting.

HUNTERS SPIRIT.text:
INSIGHT UTILITY 
Tradition verdant 
Cast 3 AP (material, somatic, verbal)
Duration 8 hours
You draw the power of nature spirits into yourself, granting you the mantle of a hunter.
You gain a +2-circumstance bonus on all Survival checks for the duration of the spell, and you do not have to move at half your speed while traveling through the wilderness or while tracking.

HURLING.text:
ATTACK CANTRIP INVOCATION
Tradition arcane, ethereal 
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Range 30 feet; Targets 1 creature
Base Damage 1d6
You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has a weight of 1 lb or less at the target. If the spell attack is successful, it inflicts 1d6 + magical ability score bludgeoning damage.
CASTER LEVEL MODIFICATIONS
CL 4+: The damage increases by 1d6.

HYDRAULIC TORRENT.text:
INVOCATION SAVE WATER 
Tradition ethereal, verdant 
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Area 60-foot line
Saving Throw Basic Fortitude
Base Damage 1d6
A powerful, swirling torrent of water materializes in a straight line, forcefully striking creatures and unattended objects it encounters while potentially pushing them away from you. The torrent inflicts 8d6 bludgeoning damage upon its targets.
Every creature within the area of effect must make a save to withstand the torrent's force, while unattended objects automatically fail. Those who fail the save are not only subjected to the damage but also forcefully pushed back 5 feet. A critical failure results in being pushed back even farther, 10 feet.

HYPERCOGNITION.text:
INSIGHT UTILITY 
Tradition ethereal 
Cast 1 AP (verbal)
Duration 1 hour (D)
You draw upon closed areas of your brain to allow you to multi-task for the duration. Once per round you may make a Detect Deception, Pierce Disguise, Recall Knowledge or Search check as a Free Action with no penalty. In addition, all such checks receive a +5-status bonus. You may dismiss the spell at any time to gain advantage on any of the above checks (which still gains the status bonus).

ICE SLICK.text:
COLD INVOCATION UTILITY
Tradition arcane, verdant 
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Range 30 feet; Area 10-foot radius
Slick ice coats the area, causing it to become difficult terrain.

ICY DRAFT.text:

Tradition arcane, verdant 
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Area 30-foot line
Saving Throw Basic Reflex
Base Damage 1d8
You release a powerful and chilling wind in a line. All affected creatures take 3d8 cold damage.

Tradition arcane, verdant 
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Area 15-foot cone
Saving Throw Basic Reflex
Base Damage 1d8

IDENTIFY.text:
INSIGHT REVELATION UTILITY
Tradition arcane 
Cast 1 minute (somatic, verbal)
Range 30 feet; Targets 1 object
You concentrate on one object within range. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical, you learn the school of magic and treat your spellcraft skill check as if you had attempted an Identify Power check for 1 round (-5) using the appropriate skill (without any penalties for failure).
If you fail to identify the object, any subsequent checks are made at +2.

IDIOCY.text:
CURSE ENCHANTMENT MENTAL SAVE
Tradition arcane, ethereal 
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Range 30 feet; Targets 1 creature
Saving Throw Will; Duration varies
You cloud the targets common sense. The target must attempt a Will save. 
Critical The target is unaffected.
Success The target is dazed 1 for 1 round.
Failure The target is dazed 1 for 1 minute.
Fumble The target is dazed 2 for 1 minute.

IMPLOSION.text:
INVOCATION SAVE
Tradition arcane, verdant 
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Range 30 feet
Targets 1 corporeal creature
Saving Throw Basic Fortitude
Base Damage 1d10
Duration Sustained (1 minute)
You exert immense force upon the target, causing it to implode upon itself and inflicting 12d10 bludgeoning damage.
Each round, when you Sustain the Spell, you must select a new target to be affected by the same crushing effect. However, a single casting of this spell cannot target the same creature more than once. Additionally, you can only affect one creature per turn with implosion. It is not possible to target creatures that are incorporeal, gaseous, liquid, or lack a solid form.
WARPING OPTIONS
+2 PP: you may target a single target twice.

INCANDESCENCE.text:
FIRE INVOCATION SAVE
Tradition arcane, verdant 
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Range 30 feet
Targets 1 metal item of up to 2 lbs
Saving Throw Reflex
This spell momentarily heats the targeted metal, causing it to become red-hot. When used on an unattended metal item, it is typically harmless and does not require a saving throw. However, the GM may determine that flammable materials connected to the object catch fire or melt.
If you target a creature wearing or carrying a metal item, or a creature primarily composed of metal, the heat inflicts 3d6 fire damage and 1d4 recurring fire damage. The affected creature must attempt a Reflex save.
If the spell targets an item held by a creature, that creature has the option to release the item, which improves their degree of success on the saving throw by one step. The recurring fire damage is associated with the item and affects whoever is holding or wearing it. If no one is holding the item, the recurring damage has no effect. However, you still need to make flat checks to end the recurring damage as usual, as the item remains hot and can burn someone who picks it up.
Critical The creature is unaffected.
Success The creature takes half damage, and the object deals no recurring fire damage.
Failure The creature takes full damage, and the object deals full recurring damage.
Fumble As failure, but the creature takes double damage, and the object deals double recurring damage.
WARPING OPTIONS
+2 PP: damage increases by 1d6 and the recurring by 1d4.

INCENDIARY CLOUD.text:

Tradition arcane, verdant 
Cast 3 AP (material, somatic, verbal)
Range 120 feet; Area 20-foot radius (P)
Saving Throw Fortitude
Duration 1 minute (D)
You flood the area with smoke and burning embers. The cloud may be stationary or move 10 ft. away from you each round (choose when the spell is cast). All creatures within the fog become concealed, and all creatures outside the fog become concealed to creatures within it. Each creature that starts its turn in the spell's area must make a saving throw.
Critical The target takes 2d6 fire damage.
Success The target takes 4d6 fire damage.
Partial The target takes 4d6 fire damage and a Minor critical.
Failure The target takes 6d6 fire damage and a Serious critical.
Fumble The target takes 8d6 fire damage and a Deadly critical. 
WARPING OPTIONS
+2 PP: damage increases by 1d6.

INDOMITABLE.text:

Tradition divinity
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Duration 10 minutes (D)
You strengthen your body and mind with the power of the gods. You reduce the dazed or weakened conditions by 2 the first time you them whilst the spell is in effect. The spell then ends.
WARPING OPTIONS
+1 PP: instead ignore the injured condition.
+2 PP: increase the amount condition ignored by 1 (max 5).
+2 PP: increase the duration to 1 hour.

INFLICT.text:
ESSENCE SAVE SOUL
Tradition divinity 
Cast 1-3 AP (see below) 
Range varies
Targets 1 living creature or 1 willing undead creature
Saving Throw Basic Will; Base Damage 1d8
You channel the power of essence to harm rather than to heal. You inflict 1d8 essence damage and 1 bleed to your target with the bleed being negated by a successful saving throw. 
The spell’s application depends upon how many AP you expend when casting.
1 AP (somatic) The spell has a range of touch.
2 AP (somatic, verbal) The spell has a range of 30 feet and also inflicts an additional 8 points of HP damage.
3 AP (material, somatic, verbal) You disperse essence in a 30-foot radius. This targets all creatures in the area.
WARPING OPTIONS
+2 PP: The amount of damage increases by 1d8 or 1d8+8 for the 2 AP version. Furthermore, the bleed increases by 1.

INNER FOCUS.text:
SHADOW UTILITY VISUAL
Tradition divinity, verdant 
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Duration 1 hour
You draw forth an illusory representation of either your spell focus item, holy symbol or a spell focus component. Whilst the spell is in effect, you do not need to provide focus spell components and take no penalty for not using your Spell Focus item.

INNER SANCTUM.text:
UTILITY WARDING
Tradition divinity, verdant 
Cast 3 AP (material, somatic, verbal)
Area 20-foot radius (P)
Duration 1 hour
You create a sanctified space reinforced by spiritual and planar boundaries. Allies within the area gain a +2-status bonus to saving throws against possession, fear and translocation spells. Furthermore, any translocation spells cast within the spells area of effect must make a counteract check against your Spell DC or fail. Finally, the spell increases the light level within its area by 1 step.

INSANITY.text:
EMOTION ENCHANTMENT SAVE 
Tradition divinity, ethereal 
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Range 30 feet; Targets 1 creature
Saving Throw Will; Duration varies
You target loses their mind for a short space of time, causing them to act randomly. The target is insane for 1 round per 2 failure and must roll on the following table at the beginning of each of their turns to determine their behaviour.
 | D10 Roll
 | Behaviour

 | 1
 | Target is unaffected this round.

 | 2-4
 | Target is stunned 1d3.

 | 5-7
 | Target is slowed 1d3

 | 8-10
 | Target is confused.

+4 PP: the target is insane for 1 round per 1 failure.

INVISIBILITY.text:
SHADOW UTILITY 
Tradition arcane, ethereal 
Cast 2 AP (material, somatic)
Duration 10 minutes
You throw a blanket of illusion across the target causing them to become invisible. This makes the target undetected to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it hidden to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.
WARPING OPTIONS
+1 PP: the spells range becomes touch, and you may target another creature. 
+4 PP: if you make a hostile action, the spell ends until the beginning of your next turn.
+10 PP: you remain invisible even if you make a hostile action.

INVISIBILITY PURGE.text:
INVOCATION UTILITY
Tradition divinity 
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Area 20-foot radius
Duration 10 minutes
You surround yourself with a sphere of power that negates all forms of invisibility. Anything invisible becomes visible while in the area.

INVISIBILITY SPHERE.text:
SHADOW UTILITY
Tradition arcane 
Cast 2 AP (material, somatic)
Area 5-foot radius
Targets you and any number of creatures in range
Duration 10 minutes
While you and all targets remain within the spell's area, you become invisible to everyone except each other. However, if a creature affected by this spell leaves the spell's area, it becomes visible and remains so even upon returning. Additionally, if any creature made invisible by this spell initiates a hostile action, the spell concludes once the hostile action is completed.
WARPING OPTIONS
+2 PP: duration increases to 1 hour.

INVISIBLE ITEM.text:
SHADOW UTILITY 
Tradition arcane 
Cast 2 AP (material, somatic)
Range touch; Targets 1 object
Duration 1 hour
You render the object invisible, causing it to become undetectable to all creatures. However, creatures can still make an attempt to locate the target, which would then render it hidden from them if they succeed. If the invisible object is used in a hostile action, the spell ends once that action is completed. Generally, making a weapon invisible does not grant any advantage to the attack, except for the fact that an invisible thrown weapon or piece of ammunition can be used without revealing information about the attacker's position unless the weapon returns to the attacker.
WARPING OPTIONS
+2 PP: the duration is until the next time you make your daily preparations.
+8 PP: the duration is unlimited.

INVULNERABILITY.text:

Tradition all 
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)

You possess the ability to determine whether or not you are affected by any external influence. IRON BODY.text:

Tradition arcane, ethereal

Tradition arcane, ethereal
Cast 2 AP (material, somatic)

Saving Throw Fortitude
You bypass the usual construct magical resistance in an attempt to slow one down. The construct must make a fortitude saving throw.

Saving Throw Will

You release a small charge of electricity which shocks the targets nervous system and inflicts 2d6 mental damage. The outcome is determined by the targets saving throw.

JUMP.text:

Tradition arcane, verdant

Your legs surge with strength, ready to leap high and far. You gain a +4-status bonus to all High Jump and Long Jump actions.

KEEN EDGE.text:
ALTERATION UTILITY 
Tradition arcane 
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Range touch
Targets one weapon or 50 projectiles, all of which must be together at the time of casting
Duration 10 minutes
This spell makes a weapon magically keen, improving its ability to deal telling blows. This transmutation grants the weapon the Keen quality. The spell can be cast only on piercing or slashing weapons. If cast on arrows or crossbow bolts, the keen edge on a particular projectile ends after one use, whether or not the missile strikes its intended target. Treat shuriken as arrows, rather than as thrown weapons, for the purpose of this spell.
You can’t cast this spell on a natural weapon, such as a claw or upon a weapon that already has the Keen quality.

+4 PP: the weapon is granted the razor trait.

KNOCK.text:

Tradition arcane, ethereal
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)

Duration 1 minute
The target becomes easier to bypass. The spell provides a +4-status bonus to any creature attempting to open the target door, lock, or container using an Athletics or Thievery check. As part of casting knock, you can make a Pick Lock (Thievery) check to open the target, using your Spellcraft bonus (without the +4) or your Thievery skill.

LAY OF THE LAND.text:

Tradition verdant 
Cast 1 minute (somatic, verbal)

In a flash of recognition, you learn about the geography of your surroundings within a radius of 5 miles. This instant familiarity grants you a +2-status bonus to Nature and Survival checks so long as you remain in the affected area.

The target item’s weight decreases by half. If this spell is cast on armour, the armour’s ACP is reduced by 1, though its categorization as light, medium, or heavy does not change.

LOCATE.text:

You gain knowledge of the direction to the target or the nearest target, depending on your selection. LOCK.text:

MAGIC JAR.text:
ESSENCE EVIL SAVE SOUL 
Tradition arcane 
Cast 1 minute (focus, somatic, verbal)
Range 120 feet; Targets 1 living creature
Duration 8 hours; Saving Throw Will Negates
By casting magic jar, you place your soul in a gem or large crystal (known as the magic jar), leaving your body lifeless. Then you can attempt to take control of a nearby body, forcing its soul into the magic jar. You may move back to the jar (thereby returning the trapped soul to its body) and attempt to possess another body. The spell ends when you send your soul back to your own body, leaving the receptacle empty. To cast the spell, the magic jar must be within spell range, and you must know where it is, though you do not need line of sight or line of effect to it. When you transfer your soul upon casting, your body is, as near as anyone can tell, dead.
While in the magic jar, you can sense and attack any life force within 100 feet. You do need line of effect from the jar to the creatures. You cannot determine the exact creature types or positions of these creatures. 
Attempting to possess a body is a 3 AP concentrate action. It is blocked by circle of protection or a similar ward. You possess the body and force the creature’s soul into the magic jar unless the subject succeeds on a Will save. Failure to take over the host leaves your life force in the magic jar, and the target automatically succeeds on further saving throws if you attempt to possess its body again.
If you are successful, your life force occupies the host body, and the host’s life force is imprisoned in the magic jar. You keep your mental ability scores, level, class, skills, loyalties, and mental abilities. The body retains its physical ability scores, HP, natural abilities, and automatic abilities. 
As a 1 AP action, you can shift freely from a host to the magic jar if within range, sending the trapped soul back to its body. The spell ends when you shift from the jar to your own body.
If the host body is slain, you return to the magic jar, if within range, and the life force of the host departs (it is dead). If the host body is slain beyond the range of the spell, both you and the host die. Any life force with nowhere to go is treated as slain.
If the spell ends while you are in the magic jar, you return to your body (or die if your body is out of range or destroyed). If the spell ends while you are in a host, you return to your body (or die, if it is out of range of your current position), and the soul in the magic jar returns to its body (or dies if it is out of range). Destroying the receptacle ends the spell, and the spell can be dispelled at either the magic jar or the host’s location.

SEE INVISIBLE.text:
INSIGHT UTILITY
Tradition arcane, divinity, ethereal 
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Duration 10 minutes

Objects and beings that would otherwise be hidden from sight become illuminated in your presence. You view invisible creatures as translucent shapes and ethereal beings take shape as eerie apparitions, each now having the concealed condition to you.

SELF MIRAGE.text:
SHADOW UTILITY VISUAL
Tradition arcane, ethereal 
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Duration 1 hour
You make yourself--including your clothing, armour, weapons, and other belongings on your person--look different. You can seem 1 foot shorter or taller and can appear thin, fat, or in between. You can't change your body type, so you must adopt a form that has the same basic arrangement of limbs. Otherwise, the extent of the illusion is up to you.
Casting illusory disguise counts as setting up a disguise for the Impersonate use of Deception; it ignores any circumstance penalties you might take for disguising yourself as a dissimilar creature, it gives you a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to prevent others from seeing through your disguise. You can Dismiss this spell.
WARPING OPTIONS
+2 PP: the spell also disguises your voice and scent, and it gains the auditory and olfactory traits 
+4 PP: you can appear as any creature of the same size, even a specific stored individual. The spell also disguises your voice and scent, and it gains the auditory trait.

Tradition ethereal 
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Range 120 feet; Targets 1 willing creature
Duration 10 minutes

SHADOW WALK.text:
TRANSLOCATION UTILITY
Tradition arcane, ethereal 
Cast 1 minute (material, somatic, verbal)
Range touch
Targets you and up to 5 willing creatures touched
Duration 8 hours (D)
You and the creatures you touch are transported along a coiling path of shadow, reaching the edge where the Material Plane meets the Plane of Shadow. Although the effect is mostly illusory, the path itself has a quasi-real nature. 
In the realm of shadows, you move swiftly at a speed of 50 miles per hour, traversing the borders between the Plane of Shadow and the Material Plane. This allows you to travel great distances by stepping onto the Plane of Shadow, moving as desired, and returning to the Material Plane.
Due to the blurred reality between the two planes, you cannot discern specific details of the terrain or areas you pass over during the journey. It is also impossible to accurately predict where your travel will conclude. This makes the spell unsuitable for scouting or spying purposes. Additionally, when the spell effect ends, the targets appear roughly 1 mile from their intended location on the Material Plane. 
Be aware, traversing the plane of shadow in this way can often draw unwanted attention and a Resonance Event occurs if you roll a 13 on the Spellcraft check made to cast the spell. 
WARPING OPTIONS
+1 PP: select an additional target.
